page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance delivers 128 physical cores with 128 vCPUs, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation with 1.0 thread per core.

This instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance class highly resource-dense for memory-bound workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity without the need for local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration.
